description: This Java class is a command handler within the Fineract project responsible for processing recurring deposit transaction adjustments. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the DepositAccountWritePlatformService to perform the adjustment operation.

classes.name: RecurringDepositTransactionAdjustmentCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to adjust recurring deposit transactions by invoking the appropriate service method.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to adjust a recurring deposit transaction, extracts transaction ID, and delegates to the deposit account service for adjustment.
